summary: A bluegrass jam at White Horse Black Mountain hosted by a band called the Jacktown Ramblers, who start the set and invite fiddle/banjo/mandolin/guitar/bass players to sit in and trade breaks. Listings frame it as a 'community jam' for pickers and fans, but nothing pins down a returning membership beyond the host band, and only two widely-spaced dates (Aug 30 and Oct 25, 2026) appear rather than a regular weekly/monthly slot.

evidence.note: Description: 'Hosted by the incredible Jacktown Ramblers, our Bluegrass Jam is a true celebration of acoustic string music, community, and tight, driving picking'; musicians are 'encouraged to bring instruments,' framed as open participation rather than a closed membership.
Second listing calls it 'a casual, community-minded gathering in an intimate listening room for pickers and fans alike' with no mention of dues, sign-up, or named regulars.

Only 2 recorded occurrences across nearly 2 months (Aug 30 -> Oct 25, 2026), a sparse cadence more consistent with occasional venue bookings of a performing band than an established weekly/monthly community jam night.
Fetched the venue's own site and events page; no bio, mention, or further detail on 'Jacktown Ramblers' appears anywhere on the venue's site.

No Facebook group/page, Meetup, Instagram, or independent website could be found for 'Jacktown Ramblers' via available search tools; the web search budget was exhausted mid-session so this is a weak negative, not a confirmed absence.
